articles.title: Vườn mưa có thể ngăn chặn ngập lụt ở các thành phố
articles.summary: Constructing rain gardens along urban streets and residential areas offers a sustainable solution to mitigate localized flooding during intense storms. These green spaces absorb and filter excess rainwater before it overwhelms municipal drainage systems. Implementing such nature-based infrastructure can significantly enhance urban climate resilience.

articles.title: Tên lửa Đức mở đường tham vọng phóng vệ tinh của châu Âu
articles.summary: The German two-stage Spectrum rocket has successfully delivered satellites into orbit. This milestone advances Europe's commercial spaceflight capabilities and reduces dependency on foreign launch providers. The breakthrough sets the stage for regular European commercial satellite missions in the near future.

articles.title: 'Đại học Huế tập trung nghiên cứu, hướng tới sản phẩm có khả năng ứng dụng'
articles.summary: Hue University is prioritizing scientific research projects that yield practical and market-ready products. Leadership emphasized focusing institutional investments on distinct regional and academic strengths to solve real-world problems. This applied research approach aims to bridge the gap between academic innovation and socio-economic development.

articles.title: Công ty Trung Quốc ra mắt robot chó dẫn đường
articles.summary: A Chinese technology firm has developed a robotic guide dog named Xiaoyuan to assist visually impaired individuals. The robot can effortlessly navigate both flat surfaces and staircases while achieving a 99 percent obstacle-avoidance success rate. This innovation showcases the transformative potential of assistive robotics in improving personal mobility and safety.

articles.title: Đảo nổi bị nhầm là ảnh AI vì 'thoắt ẩn thoắt hiện'
articles.summary: A 9,800-square-meter floating island on Williston Lake has fascinated observers due to its periodic appearances and disappearances. Covered in mature trees and supporting local wildlife, the natural landmass frequently gets mistaken for an artificial intelligence generation. Scientists explain that fluctuations in water levels cause the buoyant mass of peat and vegetation to rise and submerge naturally.

articles.title: Ông già đưa cặp mèo cưng đi khắp Nhật Bản ngắm hoa
articles.summary: A devoted pet owner in Japan travels extensively with his two rescue cats to explore scenic seasonal flower fields. From vibrant poppy blossoms to cascading wisteria and hydrangeas, their adventures offer a heartwarming showcase of scenic Japanese destinations. The journey highlights the growing trend of pet-inclusive travel and outdoor recreation.

articles.title: Bí kíp sống còn đi du lịch nước ngoài an toàn
articles.summary: Experienced travelers have shared practical safety tips for individuals exploring unfamiliar international destinations. Key recommendations include researching local customs, securely storing digital document copies, and staying alert in crowded public areas. Adopting these proactive safety habits allows visitors to navigate foreign cities with greater confidence and peace of mind.

articles.title: Đảo Bích Đầm - nơi có bãi đá tròn như trứng
articles.summary: Bich Dam Island attracts travelers seeking tranquil ecotourism with its pristine turquoise waters and untouched coastal scenery. A standout feature of the island is its unique beach composed of naturally smoothed, egg-shaped stones. This hidden gem offers a refreshing getaway for tourists wanting to escape busy urban life.

articles.title: Pressure sensors can help improve robotic gripping accuracy
articles.summary: Integrating pressure sensors into robotic end-effectors significantly enhances gripping precision during automated bin-picking tasks. These sensors monitor touch dynamics from initial contact through surface deformation and load distribution. Adopting advanced tactile sensing improves reliability and reduces damage in high-speed factory automation environments.

articles.title: Robot.com partners with Sodexo to roll out more sidewalk delivery robots
articles.summary: Robot.com has entered a partnership with Sodexo to expand autonomous sidewalk delivery fleets across university campuses. The collaborative deployment focuses on scaling contact-free food logistics in pedestrian-dense institutional environments. This initiative illustrates the rapid commercial adoption of autonomous service robotics in everyday campus life.

articles.title: Zoox Begins Robotaxi Testing in Houston
articles.summary: Autonomous vehicle developer Zoox has initiated testing of its purpose-built robotaxis on public roads in Houston. The company aims to expand its urban testing footprint and refine its autonomous driving technology in varied traffic conditions. This expansion marks another competitive step forward in the accelerating US commercial autonomous mobility sector.

articles.title: IFA Berlin Recap Part 1: Diverse Approaches To Sustainability
articles.summary: The IFA Berlin trade show featured an extensive showcase of consumer electronics and emerging green technology solutions. Innovators presented varied approaches to sustainability, ranging from AI-optimized energy efficiency to eco-friendly product designs. The event underscored the critical convergence of smart hardware development with global environmental goals.

articles.title: Architecting memory and storage in the AI era
articles.summary: The rapid rise of AI inference workloads demands modernized memory and storage architectures to prevent computational bottlenecks. High-performance data pipelines are essential for powering real-time enterprise intelligence in critical sectors like healthcare and automated services. Upgrading underlying hardware infrastructure ensures scalable and responsive machine learning deployments.

articles.title: This lifestyle program improved cognition 55% more than basic health advice
articles.summary: A structured lifestyle intervention combining physical exercise, nutritious eating, cognitive drills, and social engagement substantially improved memory in older adults at risk of dementia. Participants receiving regular coaching outperformed those who were provided only standard general wellness advice by fifty-five percent. The findings provide actionable evidence that targeted multidomain habits can actively preserve brain health.

articles.title: Compound in blueberries may help muscle cells burn excess fat
articles.summary: Japanese researchers discovered that pterostilbene, a natural compound found in berries, helps muscle cells break down fat more effectively. In laboratory models, the compound stimulated lipid metabolism and stabilized proteins responsible for fatty acid transport. This scientific insight may inform future nutritional strategies and metabolic wellness therapies.
